Dust the leather regularly, preferably once a week. Use the LCK® cleaning glove with a few drops of LCK® cleaning water or a clean cotton cloth. The transparent finish of pigmented leather provides excellent protection for the first 6 months. Then maintain the leather two to four times a year with the maintenance products from the Keralux® set P.

Additional protection is possible (also from day 1) with Keralux® strong protector. The order of a maintenance interval is always the same: dusting, cleaning, nourishing and protecting (optional). Follow the instructions on the packaging.

Name: Wash Basin
Description: Made from ultra-high performance concrete (UHPC) in a single casting; the basin features a large chamfered edge design, exuding a refined and sophisticated look while maintaining a clean finish. This minimizes the appearance of holes, resulting in a dense and uniform surface. A surface coating significantly enhances its waterproof and stain-resistant properties. Driven by a meticulous attention to detail, the concrete drain fittings are independently designed. When drainage is needed, the lid pops up, leaving a gap of approximately 3mm for drainage and also providing some filtration; when filled with water, the lid is flush with the bottom of the basin, maximizing the overall uniformity of the product.

MAINTENANCE
ND Collection ropes and fabrics are UV-resistant, but prolonged exposure to intense sunlight can still affect color and strength over time. To extend their durability, we recommend using shade or protective covers when not in use. During wet weather, rain can carry dirt and pollutants that accelerate wear. Cushions and textiles should be covered or stored in dry, ventilated spaces—especially during the off-season. Always avoid plastic wraps, which can trap moisture and lead to mildew.
 
CARE
Basic, consistent care helps preserve both appearance and performance. Gently brush off dirt, vacuum regularly, or wipe with a damp cloth to prevent buildup. For deeper cleaning, use a mild soap and water solution, rinse thoroughly, and allow to dry completely. Removable covers can be machine washed at 30°C using a gentle cycle and neutral detergent. Do not use softeners or overload the machine. Always air dry and never iron.
 
CLEANING INSTRUCTIONS
Treat stains promptly. Remove excess material with absorbent paper or a soft brush, then clean with a sponge or cloth and a mild soap solution. Rinse well, pat dry, and air dry fully before reuse. For machine washing, remove fillings, apply Velcro protection if needed, and wash covers separately on a gentle cycle. Avoid spin-intensive settings and plastic storage to maintain fabric integrity.
 
HYGIENE & SAFETY
ND Collection fabrics are fully recyclable, hypoallergenic, and resistant to bacteria and mold. They can be sanitized safely with 70% alcohol or sodium hypochlorite up to 0.5% without compromising texture or color—even after repeated cleaning. Their hydrophobic nature makes them ideal for both outdoor and indoor environments, including high-traffic or shared spaces, where hygiene and skin sensitivity are a concern.

Daily and Weekly Maintenance:
 1. Gentle Vacuuming:
 Frequency: Vacuum high-traffic areas twice weekly; other zones once a week.
 Technique: Use a vacuum with adjustable suction and a brushless attachment; avoid beater bars on delicate piles. Vacuum in the direction of the nap to lift dust without abrading fibers.
 Edge Care: Gently vacuum fringes and edges with a handheld nozzle to prevent fraying.
 2. Rotation and Sun Protection:
 Rotation: Turn your rug 180° every three months to equalize wear and fading.
 Sunlight: Prolonged exposure to direct sunlight can fade dyes and weaken fibers. Use UV-filter curtains or rotate the rug more frequently in sunlit areas.
 
 Step-by-Step Spot Treatment:
 1. Blot, don't rub: Immediately absorb excess liquid with a clean cotton cloth—press gently, working outward from the stain edge.
 2. Apply the correct James solution:
 Water-based: Spray James Stainwonder directly onto the spot; let dwell 2?3 minutes.
 Oil-based: Treat with James Stainspray, agitating lightly with the cotton cloth.
 3. Rinse & Dry: Blot with a damp cloth to remove residue, then press a dry cloth until no moisture transfers.
 4. Final touch: Use Interior Cleaner sparingly for overall refreshment, ensuring an even appearance across the rug.

Meta: maintenance_&_care:
Wipe clean regularly with a damp, white, cotton cloth to remove dust particles and prevent build-up soiling. For general dirt and stain apply mild soap and water with a soft sponge or nonabrasive cloth. Then rise with fresh water and wipe with a dry white cotton cloth to remove all moisture. Ensure that all cleaning product residues are fully rinsed out. For coffee, tea, juice like stains, absorb the excess liquid with an absorbent cloth. Allow the stain to be absorbed until all the liquid is removed from the material’s surface. After the initial surface spill has been absorbed, rub very gently with damp cloth. Finally wipe the surface with a dry white cotton cloth to remove moisture. For oil and grease like stains, wipe affected area with a clean cotton, white cloth and use a soapy cotton cloth or sponge to rub the stain. Wipe off the area with a clean, damp, cotton cloth dry the surface. For ink, ball point, pen, denim or cloth stains, rub the stain with damp cloth, these are almost impossible to remove once set. After rubbing the stain, dry with a clean white cotton cloth. Don't use hard brushes or any other abrasive items on artificial leather. Don't allow body oils, perspiration or hair products to settle on the surface of the vinyl, as these will gradually cause to crack. Don't use cleaning agents like thinner, acetone, nail varnish remover, furniture polish, stain remover, solvent, alcohol, synthetic detergent and other harmful household products as these can damage the surface. Please, keep in mind that colouring by indigo dyed from denim & canvas garments or other textiles are excluded from any manufacturer’s guarantee. Dyes can be migrated onto all light coloured vinyl’s and can be impossible to remove. If you do wish to apply preparatory vinyl care products or cleaners, before use, always test on a small area that cannot be seen. If necessary, please use diluted alcohol solution 30% for cleaning.

Adding baking soda and vinegar to the washing machine when doing laundry have will remove any bacteria from the fabric. Prepare a solution of bleach (maximum 5% per 1l of water) and mild soap (use of bleach may impact the deterioration of the sewing thread and other elements of the ready-made product) 2. Spray on the entire area and allow to soak into the fabric for 15min 3. Clean the entire surface with a sponge, clean towel or a very soft bristle brush 4.
